name: Text Statistics
description: Writing tool: Project > Text Statistics counts the selected text, the documents in the editor or the binder selection, the Draft or the whole project: words, characters, sentences, averages, readability estimates (Flesch, Flesch-Kincaid, Amstad, Wiener Sachtextformel, LIX), word frequency with common words hidden, repeated phrases and a table of the documents. Tables can be exported for a spreadsheet.
author: Quillbinder
